sn17.37:1.2: Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya || || 3
sn17.37:1.3: Idhāhaṃ bhikkhave ekaccam puggalam evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi ||
sn17.37:1.4: na cāyam āyasmā mātu pi hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyāti || ||
sn17.37:1.5: Tam enam passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtam pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ || || 4
sn17.37:1.6: Evam dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya || || 5
sn17.37:1.7: Tasma ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
sn17.37:1.9: na ca no uppanno lābhasakkāra siloko cittam pariyādāya ṭhassatīti || || 6
